name: Sotsiopat
source:
Sociopathy is a personality disorder characterized by antisocial behavior, a disregard for social norms, impulsivity, and sometimes a combination of aggressiveness with an extremely limited ability to form attachments. In the latest edition of the American manual of mental disorders, the DSM-5, it is noted that "psychopathy" and "sociopathy" are synonymous with antisocial personality disorder.

It is always some distinct personality that ends up in Sovyonok: sometimes Semyon is a psychopath, sometimes a crybaby, sometimes an alpha, sometimes a killer, etc. But what if we combine all of those into one? What if the unusual arrival happens not through a bus, but through death? What if Sovyonok is Hell? Or maybe Heaven? A ton of questions with zero answers. If you are intrigued, welcome to Hell.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1801140803]Steam[/url]]
translation:
社交病是一种人格障碍，其特征是反社会行为、无视社会规范、冲动，有时还兼具攻击性和极其有限的形成依恋的能力。在最新版的美国精神障碍手册DSM-5中，指出“精神病”和“社会病”是反社会人格障碍的同义词。

在《索维诺克》中，总是有一些独特的个性：有时谢苗是一个精神病患者，有时是一个爱哭鬼，有时是一个阿尔法，有时是一个杀手，等等。但如果我们将所有这些结合在一起呢？如果不寻常的到达不是通过公共汽车而是通过死亡发生怎么办？如果索维诺克是地狱怎么办？或者也许是天堂？一大堆问题，答案为零。如果你感兴趣，欢迎来到地狱。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1801140803]Steam[/url]]
